title: The Silence of the family house on Kessler Street
author: Lena Oyelaran
blurb: Orsen Galloway, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
